position_caps.caps_note: Mirrors momentum crypto caps (25% single / 20% min cash). max_concurrent_positions=4. max_new_trades_per_day=6 spam cap. Rule v3 2026-10-06: max_new_trades_per_day=6 counts BUY entries only; exits (trend break / ATR stop) are never capped. Buys under min_order_usd ($1,000) are skipped as dust and use no cap slot. Rule v4 2026-10-06: open positions under min_order_usd are dust; they do not count toward max_concurrent_positions and are sold as uncapped exits (liquidate_dust_positions). Rule v5 2026-10-06: reentry_cooldown_bars=4 (1 hour) blocks re-buying a ticker after any SELL of it (Freqtrade CooldownPeriod style).

rebalance.note: Live scan+book on 15m bars 24/7 (driven by market_hours_refresh / run_active.py). Exits on EMA bearish cross or ATR stop; entries on bullish cross/state into open slots. Separate from weekly momentum crypto sleeve.
